notes: No inbound webhooks: the tunnel exposes the API (GET /healthz, GET /readyz, /v1/*) so testers' extensions can reach it.
dist/extension-tunnel is built with VITE_API_BASE_URL=<tunnel URL>: zip it or load it unpacked; rebuild on every run (quick tunnel URLs change).
The API uses the local Docker Postgres (5434) and Redis (6380); ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and other settings still come from .env.
npm run dev:extension (HMR on :5174) keeps targeting http://localhost:3040.
